definitions.explanation: A sculptural representation of a person, animal, or deity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{銅|どう}{像|ぞう}→銅像：14471_douzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}っている→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A bronze statue stands in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仏|ほとけ}{像|ぞう}→仏像：09638_butsuzou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拝|おが}む→拝む：00328_ogamu⟧。
⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{仏|ぶつ}{像|ぞう}→仏像：09638_butsuzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many old Buddha statues at the temple.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鏡|かがみ}→鏡：02190_kagami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{映|うつ}った→映る：12964_utsuru⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{像|ぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw my own image reflected in the mirror.

examples.japanese: ⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映|えい}{像|ぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぼやけている→ぼやける：16967_boyakeru⟧。
examples.notes: ⟦{映|えい}{像|ぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧ = image, video

examples.japanese: ⟦{画|が}{像|ぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦ファイル→ファイル：05280_fairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きすぎて→大きい：00335_ookii⟧、⟦{送|おく}れなかった→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: The image file was too large and couldn't be sent.

notes:
{像|ぞう} has two main meanings: a physical statue or sculpture, and a visual image or reflection. It frequently appears as a suffix in compounds.

STATUE COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{銅|どう}{像|ぞう}→銅像：14471_douzou⟧ (bronze statue)
- ⟦{石|せき}{像|ぞう}→石像：17183_sekizou⟧ (stone statue)
- ⟦{仏|ぶつ}{像|ぞう}→仏像：09638_butsuzou⟧ (Buddha statue)
- ⟦{彫|ちょう}{像|ぞう}→彫像：22319_chouzou⟧ (carved statue, sculpture)
- {胸|きょう}{像|ぞう} (bust)

IMAGE COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{映|えい}{像|ぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧ (image, video footage)
- ⟦{画|が}{像|ぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧ (digital image, picture file)
- ⟦{想|そう}{像|ぞう}→想像：02489_souzou⟧ (imagination, mental image)
- {肖|しょう}{像|ぞう} (portrait)

WATCH OUT:
⟦{象|ぞう}→象：03328_zou⟧ (elephant) is written with a different kanji. The context usually makes the meaning clear.
